description: This file contains functions for processing OpenGraph metadata in the Mattermost server, including fetching, parsing, URL normalization, and proxy handling.

classes.name: opengraph.OpenGraph
classes.description: Struct representing OpenGraph metadata, including URLs, images, videos, and other metadata.

methods.name: GetOpenGraphMetadata
methods.description: Fetches and caches OpenGraph metadata for a given URL.

methods.name: parseOpenGraphMetadata
methods.description: Parses HTML content to extract OpenGraph metadata, normalizes URLs, and applies proxy if needed.

methods.name: forceHTMLEncodingToUTF8
methods.description: Converts HTML content to UTF-8 encoding based on content type.

methods.name: makeOpenGraphURLsAbsolute
methods.description: Converts relative URLs in OpenGraph data to absolute URLs based on the request URL.

methods.name: openGraphDataWithProxyAddedToImageURLs
methods.description: Modifies OpenGraph image URLs to route through a proxy.

methods.name: filterSVGImagesFromOpenGraph
methods.description: Removes SVG images from OpenGraph metadata.

methods.name: openGraphDecodeHTMLEntities
methods.description: Unescapes HTML entities in OpenGraph title and description.

methods.name: parseOpenGraphFromOEmbed
methods.description: Creates OpenGraph metadata from an oEmbed response.
